chapters.text: All company money on one screen: where it is, where it went, and whether there is a bill for it.
Opens on the last complete month; use the arrows to change month.
Top row: cash in hand, cash with branches, what the company owes staff, what you put in.
Proof score shows how much spending has a bill. Click it to see the entries without one.
Needs your attention lists big expenses without a bill and possible double entries.
In the 10 biggest expenses, look at the bill and click Mark checked.
